correctness.rationale: The exact graph definition generates two equal exhaustive sets of 59,203 faces; ascending and descending integer acyclic matchings are verified against all 333,390 Hasse incidences. Integral Morse boundary ranks are (1,6,56,6) and (2,19,51,4) respectively; elementary unit row/column pivots reduce all matrices to zero residual, proving each nonzero Smith invariant factor equals 1. Independent full unreduced mod-2 ranks and Euler characteristic agree; no extrapolation from finite tests is needed for this exact finite complex.

value.rationale: Petersen is the canonical cubic girth-five ten-vertex graph; its exact multipath integral invariant has natural relevance beyond the existing directed paths/polygons and matching-complex comparisons. The full four-degree torsion-free Betti vector, including 94 degree-seven classes despite 240 degree-eight faces and no top homology, is structural information not implied by an Euler count, a field computation alone or general bounded-torsion results. This is a motivated complete finite invariant, not an arbitrary slice.
